_readme: The OnlyBoosts exclusion list. Anything named here is filtered out of every
published surface: the JSON shards behind the feeds, the D1 projection behind
/api/v1, the show/episode pages, search, the podroll graph, and the counts on
/about. Nothing here is deleted from the collector's own index, so removing an
entry from this file puts the content back on the next pipeline run.
Every entry carries a `reason`. That is the point of the file: what is hidden
and why is readable by anyone, in one place, in the public repo.
FOUR LISTS, and which surfaces each one covers:
shows     — a whole feed and every boost to it. Covers ALBUMS too: an album
is a show with <podcast:medium>music, not a separate thing.
Identify it by `guid` (the <podcast:guid>, which is the last
path segment of an onlyboosts.social/show/<guid> URL) or by
`feed` (the RSS URL, exact match). Either is enough; use `feed`
when a takedown request names a feed we may not have indexed
yet, and it starts working the moment we do.
episodes  — one episode and its boosts. Covers SONGS for the same reason.
`guid` is the <guid> of the item (sometimes a URL — copy it
verbatim from the episode page URL).
boosters  — every boost sent by one person, plus their profile. `npub` (or
`pubkey` in hex).
boosts    — a single boost note, left everywhere else intact. `id` is the
64-char Nostr event id.
ENTRY FIELDS: the id field above, `reason` (required, free text), and
optionally `added` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `source` (who asked, or how we found it).
You do not have to get the LIST right, only the id. A guid is matched against
every identity slot on a boost, because some apps sign an episode's guid into
the show tag and vice versa. Put an id in whichever list describes it and it
will catch the boosts that mean it.
A typo is not silently ignored. An unknown list name, an entry with no id, or
an entry with no reason stops the pipeline rather than publishing something
that was meant to be hidden. Validate an edit before it goes live with:
python3 bots/global-boost-scan/onlyboosts_globalscan.py excludes
which parses this file and reports exactly what each entry currently hides.

boosts.reason: Misclassified: this is a 121-sat boost to Chad and Reeds Podcast that the Local Bitcoiners publisher bot claimed as a boost to Local Bitcoiners, so the note carries LB's podcast guid and would be counted against that show. The cause was on our side: OnlyBoosts had just started attaching BoostBox payment metadata to lnaddress legs and was sending the show and episode under the boostagram TLV's field names (podcast, episode) rather than the RSS-payment names (feed_title, item_title). Tardbox renders only the fields it knows, so the boost page had no Show row, and LB's feed gate accepts a boost whose feed is ABSENT rather than positively another show. Fixed in ob-v108, which sends feed_title and item_title; the same boost is separately and correctly indexed from the note OnlyBoosts published for it.
boosts.source: Found by Reed on 2026-08-21 while testing the Helipad metadata work; diagnosed against LB's boost_formatter.py and the two tardbox pages.
